verdict.rationale: The evidence shows developer building blocks rather than an installable marketplace of prebuilt integrations. Developers can build apps and publish them for the community, users can connect via Zapier, and workflows can send Slack alerts. Nothing documents an ops-facing marketplace where prebuilt Slack, support desk, marketing or data warehouse integrations are installed, so these items are adjacent only.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can install prebuilt integrations (Slack, support desk, marketing, data warehouse) from an app marketplace
